name: Pipeliners - GSC Comparison Jun vs Sep 2026
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-24

# Summary
Google Search Console comparison (Domain property, Web, United States) captured Sep 24, 2026. Both months use days 1 to 21 because September was not over and the last GSC days were partial.

# Key findings
- Jun 1 to 21 vs Sep 1 to 21: clicks 31 to 32 (+3.2%), impressions 13,983 to 14,555 (+4.1%), CTR flat at 0.22%, average position 43.1 to 46.1.
- Branded (GSC "Query: Branded" filter): clicks 8 to 13, impressions 79 to 62, position 1.9 to 1.8, CTR 10.1% to 21%.
- Everything else (total minus branded): clicks 23 to 19.
- Reference only: Sep 1 to 23 = 33 clicks, 15,398 impressions. Full June = 53 clicks, 20,586 impressions.
- GSC shows a flat picture while Search Atlas estimates traffic down 38%; GSC is Google's own data and more reliable.

# Decisions and status
- Recommended: re-pull full September (Sep 1 to 30) on or after Oct 3 and compare with full June.
- Evidence: four screenshots (gsc-02 to gsc-05).
